subject.title: [Feature]: Talk/Voice tab — agent/session switching + per-agent TTS voice

question: Should the remaining Talk/Voice selector work land Android-first using existing gateway agent/session state, or wait for a shared Android/iOS/macOS Talk UX decision?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the issue explicitly covers multiple companion apps and session routing affects user-visible conversation state, so automation should not choose the permanent UX or platform scope.

options.title: Android-first Talk selector
options.body: Implement the Android Voice/Talk picker first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before expanding to other companion apps.

options.title: Shared companion-app design
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers choose one common Talk/Voice selector model for Android, iOS, and macOS.

options.title: Wait for Chat selector outcome
options.body: Defer Talk/Voice routing until the Android Chat selector PR is repaired or closed, then reuse any accepted session-state model if it fits Talk.

recommendation.title: Android-first Talk selector
recommendation.body: Implement the Android Voice/Talk picker first, wire it to existing gateway agent/session state, and validate real multi-agent Talk routing before expanding to other companion apps.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already scoped the landed TTS half versus the remaining Talk/Voice selector work in the issue discussion and has the clearest product-context signal.
